stages.input: inputs/l0-{case}.txt plus inputs/policy.txt and the policy's allowed generic resources
Only a neutral-named copy of case-{case}/l1.png and a generic transcription instruction
Only case-{case}/l2.txt plus the same generic policy/resources; no L0, L1 or comparison feedback
Only a neutral-named copy of case-{case}/l3.png and the same generic transcription instruction

judges.input: Only the three frozen descriptions and generic semantic protocol/validator; no images or original source cases

isolation: No inherited task conversation. Input restrictions and source attestations were recorded through the host tools; per-worker filesystem access was not sandboxed. Ordinary standing model/host instructions still existed.
policy: inputs/policy.txt was frozen before generation; its hash is in summary.json. No scenario-specific comparison findings were fed back to any generator or reader.
authoring_repairs: Generators could inspect their own PNG and repair layout before freezing. No diagram or description was repaired after reading/judgment. One measured chain per case, not one low-level render attempt.
judge_calibration: Judges for 01/04 received a scope clarification that faithful added C4 labels are allowed notation. The same clarification was included in the generic protocol for 02/03. Added hosting/ownership/lifecycle/scope remains drift. No desired outcome or hidden source diagram was supplied.

renderer.integration: Pinned local viewer/stencils with catalog-allowlisted SVG resources embedded into rendered evidence; no Desktop test
renderer.external_browser_networking: Background networking disabled; external DNS blocked; runtime scripts local; SVG assets read from the pinned local checkout

model: Inherited host-session model. Exact identity and sampling parameters were not exposed by the worker interface; no cross-model diversity is claimed.
provider_authority: No separately configured NVIDIA or other external model API endpoint was invoked. Workers ran using the existing app agent capability.
input_status: Resolved client-neutral synthetic fixtures, with declared choices and retained unknowns; not owner-confirmed deployed architectures. Original raw-case clarification behavior is not the subject of these full-chain runs.
artifact_privacy: The retained PNGs/SVGs are model-generated synthetic test diagrams, not private client sample images or real deployment screenshots.
automation_limit: The app agent orchestrated live worker launches. The repository does not yet contain a configured standalone model adapter that launches this full chain from one npm command.
